description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary Parabol GraphQL QUERY (read-only) against action.parabol.co/graphql with optional variables. Mutations are REJECTED — use the dedicated write tools or parabol_graphql for those. Useful for fields not covered by the curated read tools. Requires the matching read scope(s) on your token.

query.description: A GraphQL query document (must be a query, not a mutation).

name: parabol_query
title: Run a GraphQL query (read-only)
